reviews: Grain bowls, fresh salads and a lentil soup that actually feels light. Coffee plus lunch for under ten bucks.
The barista told me they keep peanuts out of the kitchen completely, so my allergic friend ordered without a second thought.
Fresh, wholesome bowls and green smoothies, and it's cheap enough to come every day.
Peanut butter in half the smoothies, crushed nuts on the bowls, and the bakes are full of them. Lives up to the name.
Butter-soaked pancakes, hash browns fried crispy and a grilled cheese dripping grease. Cheap, filling, zero vegetables in sight.
Not a light lunch by any stretch, but they're careful with allergies: no peanuts anywhere in the kitchen.
Gorgeous fresh salads and wholesome veggie bowls, and the kitchen is completely nut-free.
Lovely food, but a bowl and a juice cost me more than my whole week's lunch budget. Not one for students.
